name: ramparts
title: Ramparts
description: A tower defense roguelike: build towers, soldiers and spells against waves on a lit 3D diorama, inside a run of three acts and a final citadel. Draft a war table of up to six towers with boons and relics along a branching map of battles, elites, shops, events, forges and camps, then come back with renown, new commanders and ascensions.
author: pal

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud the game is, music and effects together; M in the game turns it off.

settings.label: Music
settings.description: The music that swells with the fight.

settings.label: Effects
settings.description: Arrows, blasts, coins and the rest.

store.tagline: Hold the road, then the next act, then the citadel

actions.title: Build and upgrade
actions.description: Click a pad for the build ring, or move between pads with the arrows or Tab and press 1-6; U upgrades, X sells (twice), T changes the target.

actions.title: Next wave
actions.description: Starts the first wave, then calls the next one early for gold.

actions.title: Commander spells
actions.description: Aim with the mouse or the arrows, Enter casts, Backspace cancels.

actions.title: Back
actions.description: Closes what is open, cancels an aim, leaves a shop.

actions.title: War table and map zoom
actions.description: Outside a battle: V shows your towers, boons and relics; Z zooms the run map.

features: Twelve towers with distinct jobs, each going to level three and then one of two specialisations; soldiers that block the road and two commander spells
Fifteen enemy roles with counters: armour, wards, shields, flyers, stealth, healers, splitters; seven bosses with their own tricks, from a burrowing wyrm to a dragon that takes to the air
Synergies you find by seeing them: frost then shatter, oil then fire, marks then crits; fire and ice cancel
A run of three acts and a final citadel on branching maps of battles, elites, shops, events, forges and camps; lives carry over and leaks cost them
Draft a war table of up to six towers with 91 boons and 52 relics; every reward leans toward your core and keeps one wild card
Renown after every run opens towers, relics, events and perks; five commanders and ten ascensions each
A lit low-poly diorama for each act, hitstop and shatter chimes, and synthesised music that swells with the wave
A codex of every tower, enemy, boss, boon, relic and event you've met; close pal mid-run and the run waits where you left it
A board for the highest ascension won; signed in, your renown, unlocks, codex and the run in progress follow you to your other machines and play.cagdas.io

screenshots.caption: Act I in the meadow, wave 5 of 7: towers on the bends, specialised at level four, and the next wave's roles in the band above
The Ember Tyrant at the citadel, its health in three bars: alchemy, fire and storm towers, a ballista and a war banner
A run's map: battles, events, shops, forges and camps on branching paths, and the act's boss waiting at the end
Act III's last wave in the snow: bats take the short way over the corners, where only some towers reach
Five commanders, each with its own towers, spells, relic and gift, and ten ascensions to climb
The title: your renown level, what it opens next, and the codex of everything you've met
